NBA DFS Picks for Thursday, October 29 (DraftKings)

DraftKings main slate · Thursday, October 29 · 3 games · First game 8:00 PM ET · By Chris Spags · · Numbers as of October 29, 1:31 PM ET

Jalen Johnson (ATL) is the top-projected player on the Thursday, October 29 DraftKings main slate at 50.0 DraftKings points for $9,500. Domantas Sabonis (SAC, 48.6, $9,200) and Deni Avdija (POR, 42.9, $7,800) are next.

Deni Avdija (POR) returns the most per dollar among players projected for at least 20 points: 5.50 projected points per $1,000 at $7,800.

Every projection is a SPAGS model estimate from the October 29, 1:31 PM ET run of the Splash Play NBA model. This page updates each time the main-slate numbers are run, and NBA projections move with every injury report, so check the time above before you build.

How to use these numbers

A projection is a starting point. Salary decides who fits: the Pts/$1K column shows what each player returns for his price. A late scratch changes the minutes and shots of everyone around him, so the numbers from an earlier run can be out of date by the first game.
